opennyai_summary.7_February_2025__facts:
The present appellant has been convicted for commission of offence punishable under Sections 366,
376 d(a) of the Indian Penal Code & Section 5/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and sentenced to undergo 07 years' RI along with fine of Rs.5,000/-, Life Imprisonment along with fine of Rs.5,000/- and 20 years' RI along with fine of Rs.5,000/- with default stipulation.
opennyai_summary.7_February_2025__ANALYSIS:
The DNA report is against Shankar and only one oral allegation against the appellant for commission of rape.
He is in jail since last seven years.
He is 25 years of age and he has no criminal records since at the most he is liable to be convicted under Section 366 of IPC for which he has undergone seven years jail sentence, therefore, in such circumstances, counsel prays for suspension of jail sentence.
Considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case so also the fact that the prosecutrix is a consenting party, we deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the present appellant.
opennyai_summary.7_February_2025__decision:
Accordingly, I.A. No.369/2025 stands allowed.
The execution of remaining jail sentence of appellant - Mukesh is hereby suspended and it is ordered that these appellant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with a solvent surety of the like amount to the Banti @ Bankat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170762799/

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
1. The appellant Banti @ Bankat has filed the present application under Section 430 of Bnss for
suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail.
2.  The present appellant has been convicted for commission of offence punishable under Sections 366, 376 d(a) of the Indian Penal Code & Section 5/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and sentenced to undergo 07 years' RI along with fine of Rs.5,000/-, Life Imprisonment along with fine of Rs.5,000/- and 20 years' RI along with fine of Rs.5,000/- with default stipulation.
3.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the sentence of co- accused Mukesh has been already been suspended by this Court vide order dated 07.02.2025 and there is parity with the appellant to co-accused Mukesh.
4.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of custodial sentence filed on behalf of the appellant deserves 2 CRA-692-2021 to be allowed.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
5. Accordingly, I.A.No.3007/2025 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellant is hereby suspended till the final disposal of this appeal.
It is directed that appellant be released on bail subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand Only) with solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 11.08.2025 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
List for final hearing in due course.
